typedef_visibility.conclusion: All five typedefs are visible to the checker and none differs in shape from classes the checker already handles. Typedef resolution is NOT the failure. The failure is that raw preprocessor text is scanned as declaration text.

mechanical_cause.common: consumer_closure._header_callback_param scans the raw text of every admitted header for '<symbol>(' and treats any match whose same-line prefix is not empty and does not end in '=', '.', '->' or ',' as a function declaration. It does not skip preprocessor directives or backslash-continued macro bodies.
mechanical_cause.arm_non_callback: Eight sites are refused by 'a declaration does not declare the parameter as a callback'. In each case the real declaration is found and classified correctly, but at least one '#define' macro invocation of the same symbol is also admitted as a declaration; that macro's parameter is an argument expression such as ossl_check_*_type(freefunc) or CHECKED_I2D_OF(type, i2d), which is not a callback, and the 'if non:' arm refuses the whole symbol.
mechanical_cause.arm_inconsistent: One site (PEM_ASN1_read_bio) is refused by 'inconsistent callback declarations'. All four admitted matches are callbacks, but three are macro invocations whose literal parameter text differs from the real declaration, so the set of (type_typedef, parameter_text) pairs has size four instead of one.
